sections.text: Help us make change by participating in our projects

We use Participatory Action Research (PAR), working with people with lived experience to shape and carry out our research. As part of this our peer researchers often run workshops and conduct interviews with members of the community. All our opportunities are paid, as we believe people should be recognised for their time and expertise in contributing to our work. Below are our current opportunities to get involved with the work we do. New opportunities are added regularly.

We are looking for Disabled people and those with long-term health conditions aged 18+ in England and Wales to take part in one-to-one online interviews with our community researchers about changes to Universal Credit. Interviews will be approximately one hour long, and as a thank you interviewees will each receive a £20 payment. More details can be found on our information sheet.
Young Disabled Londoners in Temporary Accommodation Workshops

We are currently looking for young Disabled people aged 18-26 years old in London who are either in temporary accommodation or have been in temporary accommodation within the past three years to join paid online and in-person workshops in July and August 2026. As a thank you participants will each receive a payment of £20 per hour for their time (up to £40 total). More details can be found on Disability Rights UK’s project page
